paragraphs.text: Truss is a Vedalken rogue employee who works as the chief engineer of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Truss is a hacker by trade that originally hacked the park for fun. When Myra discovered this, she hired her, as Truss was better than anyone already working in the park. Since the park is "held together like spit and duct tape, chaos galore," having someone knowledgeable to help better keep things together is a plus. Truss is very good at what she does, questionable or not. She tries her best to fix things and keep the park running, despite those solutions never being permanent.
Truss has a long-suffering assistant named Glaxxar . As Truss is an often neglectful taskmaster boss, who gets lost in her tasks, Glaxxar sometimes gets the short end of the stick.
